convert_sd3_checkpoint: run the script to convert an SD3 checkpoint to diffusers format with --checkpoint_path and --output_path
convert_sd3_transformer: call convert_sd3_transformer_checkpoint_to_diffusers to map original SD3 state dict keys to diffusers transformer keys
load_original_checkpoint: use load_original_checkpoint to load a safetensors checkpoint and strip model.diffusion_model prefix from keys
swap_scale_shift: call swap_scale_shift to swap shift and scale chunks in AdaLayerNormContinuous weights for diffusers compatibility
convert_sd3_with_dtype: run the script with --dtype flag to convert SD3 checkpoint to fp16, bf16, or fp32 format
